title: policy telemetry bridge and config drift sentinel
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a lightweight sentinel service and telemetry bridge that continuously compares policy-as-code (desired config) for data residency and retention against observed runtime configuration across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Produce verifiable evidence bundles for auditors and expose automated remediation hooks for low-risk divergence. This ticket covers: telemetry ingestion adapters, canonical diffing engine, evidence bundle format, remediation playbooks, and console integrations for findings & approvals.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel scans scheduled to run at configurable cadence (default: 1h) and can also be triggered ad-hoc
System produces signed evidence bundles (JSON + signature + provenance headers) for each detected high/medium drift
Detections mapped to policy-as-code rules from the canonical policy repo with human-readable rationale
Console shows findings with links to evidence bundle, suggested remediation, and one-click create-PR / rollback actions for supported environments
Automatic remediation can be enabled per-customer with runbook and dry-run mode; successful remediation must emit audit events to the audit-log pipeline
Telemetry bridge translates vendor/config-schema differences into the canonical model for residency/retention (region, storage-class, TTL, legal-hold flags) with >=95% mapping coverage in test matrix
Integration tests validating detection and remediation across 3 deployment patterns (hosted API tenant, dedicated GPU pool, private VPC) included in the CI job
notes: We intentionally separate detection and remediation: findings are surfaced by default; remediation requires per-customer opt-in or a separate RBAC-enabled automation role
Evidence bundle format should be small (<= 1MB typical) and include resource diffs, timestamps, signed resolver chain, and links to the model of truth commit
Consider using our existing signer service (work from infra) to avoid introducing new key material management
This implementation must not perform destructive changes without a two-step approval flow for private deployments
We need to coordinate with Customer Success for customers with custom retention contracts (legal-hold exceptions)
tasks: Design canonical telemetry model for residency & retention (schema + mapping docs)
Implement connector adapters for: hosted control plane, dedicated control plane, private-agent API
Build diff engine that compares desired-policy JSON with live-config snapshots and classifies divergence severity
Implement evidence bundle signer + storage path (s3/internal-store) and TTL
Console UI: findings list, detail view, suggested remediation actions, signature verification UI
Add feature flag and per-customer opt-in toggle for automated remediation
Write e2e tests and a small simulated-customer harness for canary testing
Coordinate release notes and runbook with Security and Customer Success
decisions: Use JSON-LD-lite as the basis for the evidence bundle to make provenance machine-readable
Classification tiers: HIGH (data residency violation), MEDIUM (retention mismatch), LOW (irrelevant metadata mismatch)
Remediation actions will be implemented first as non-destructive API calls (patch/create) and only escalate to destructive ops after explicit approval
Telemetry bridge will be implemented as a separate service behind the compliance namespace to limit blast radius
